fdb82b951699: Each book remembers where you were, so a tile takes you back to the same place.
b16fa3cca459: On Home, click a book tile, for example Titus. A book you haven't opened before starts in Understand.
7b7e47110214: In the list on the left, click a chapter number (1).
74919cd500b9: To open another book of the project, click its name in the list.
f239a66142ac: If the list is hidden, click the Toggle book list button (2) next to the chapter heading.
2edac6f378f7: The heading above the text (for example "Titus 1") tells you where you are.
c291b52a763a: The percentage under each book shows how much of it is drafted.
30ab5b145470: A large project can show Opening the project… for a moment while tC4 reads its saved work.
